g.text: yes
an Azure run, a grid report or a
verify waiting for a runner?
start nothing this tick
(Azure first)
read every started run back from its name;
never start one twice
the reruns: A of every benchmark on the engine
that stands, then B, then C; a few a tick
(scripts/reruns.txt)
the cloud queues: the next set of each family's
queue whose switch is on (Azure, Google and
Amazon on)
the grid: every square not yet started, up to
what GitHub runs plus a margin
nothing cancelled; a problem found in a run is
fixed and the run made again
